question: At the exact 435-run outcome-blind snapshot, does the previously frozen 25-percent dominant-task guard pass, improve without passing, or worsen?
scientific_scope: Decision Corpus benchmark-balance audit only; no predictor effect, accuracy, utility, or causal acquisition claim

unchanged_contract.membership: provisional first-960 in frozen chronological order
unchanged_contract.inputs: structural gate, accumulator summary and ledger, receipt-only canonical common-support verification
unchanged_contract.producer_verifier: task-balance structural-only v2 producer A/B plus non-importing verifier A/B

ordered_interpretation.condition: current dominant share <= 0.25 and current debt == 0
ordered_interpretation.allowed_claim: the provisional benchmark currently satisfies the frozen structural task-balance cap

ordered_interpretation.condition: cap fails, but dominant share and debt are both lower than the public ad0b reference (850/2884 and debt 516)
ordered_interpretation.allowed_claim: balance debt decreased descriptively, while the frozen cap still fails
the new accrual does not provide a positive task-balance update

baseline debt, current debt, and exact debt delta
all failed attempts and security receipts
